sources.title: C2PA Specifications (content provenance)

claims.text: Per the homepage, the organisation publishes an open provenance standard with Content-Credentials history (nutrition-label analogy) verifiable by consumers at any time, governed by a multi-stakeholder steering committee (listed members include Adobe/Amazon/BBC/Google/Meta/Microsoft/OpenAI/Sony/TikTok/Truepic).
claims.context: Homepage body; spec-level construction not present on page.

limitations.text: Marketing-page scope; no technical manifest, trust-list, or audio/music-binding details; deployment evidence needs vendor/spec sources.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Any generation-relevant provenance guarantee (signing, tamper-evidence, audio binding, detector robustness) not established.
